data.summary: Kavita wants to redo her 3BHK flat in Aundh (about 1,100 sq ft): kitchen, wardrobes in both bedrooms and the living room, complete by end of February. She asked about cost twice; the agent explained pricing depends on site, materials and scope and is covered at the free consultation. She is the owner. A consultation was booked for Friday 18 September at 4 pm.

entities.scope: Kitchen, wardrobes in both bedrooms, living room
entities.notes_for_designer: Asked twice for a rough cost before agreeing to book; expect pricing questions early in the consultation.

data.transcript:
[12:19:20] AGENT: Namaste, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded so our designers have your details. How can I help you today?

[12:19:27] USER: Hi. I want to redo my flat in Aundh. 3BHK, about 1,100 square feet. What might it cost?

[12:19:36] AGENT: Pricing depends on the site, the materials you choose, and the scope — your designer will walk you through it in detail at the consultation. I can book that for you right now if you'd like.

[12:19:47] USER: Maybe. What would you be doing?

[12:19:50] AGENT: Tell me what you're planning, and I'll make sure the designer has it. Which rooms are you thinking of?

[12:19:56] USER: Kitchen, wardrobes in both bedrooms, living room. But seriously, can't you give me even a rough range? I just want to know if we're in the same ballpark.

[12:20:08] AGENT: I understand why you'd want that. Any number I give you now could be far off, because it really depends on your site and the materials you pick. The consultation is free, and your designer gives you a proper figure at the end of it.

[12:20:22] USER: Fine. Let's book then.

[12:20:25] AGENT: Wonderful. May I have your name?

[12:20:28] USER: Kavita.

[12:20:31] AGENT: Thank you, Kavita. When would you need the project complete?

[12:20:36] USER: By the end of February.

[12:20:40] AGENT: That works. And are you the owner of the flat?

[12:20:43] USER: Yes, it's mine.

[12:20:47] AGENT: I have Thursday 17 September at 11 am, or Friday 18 September at 4 pm. Which would you like?

[12:20:55] USER: Friday at 4.

[12:20:58] AGENT: Could I have an email address for the booking?

[12:21:03] USER: kavita dot a at example mail dot com.

[12:21:10] AGENT: That's k, a, v, i, t, a, dot, a, at examplemail dot com. Correct?

[12:21:15] USER: Yes.

[12:21:22] AGENT: You're booked for a studio consultation on Friday 18 September at 4 pm. The booking is confirmed.

[12:21:28] USER: Thanks.

[12:21:30] AGENT: Thank you, Kavita. Your designer will see you on Friday 18 September at 4 pm and will go through the details, including pricing, with you then.
